title: A map of coherent modules injective, surjective or bijective on one stalk is so on a neighbourhood
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ a homomorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $x\in X$, with stalks and stalk maps $\varphi_x:\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal F_x$ as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]; for an open $U\subseteq X$, $\mathcal F|_U$ is the restriction ($\mathcal F|_U(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ open). (1) If $\mathcal F_x=0$, there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ with $\mathcal F|_U=0$. (2) If $\varphi_x$ is injective, there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ such that $\varphi|_U$ is injective (on the sections over every open $V\subseteq U$). (3) If $\varphi_x$ is surjective, there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ such that $\varphi|_U$ is surjective (as a map of sheaves). (4) If $\varphi_x$ is bijective, there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ such that $\varphi|_U:\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules.

proof.text: Extract finite type of F from coherence [pqf-def-coherent], using Mathlib SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. All restrictions are Mathlib overFunctor restrictions of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and stalk maps are the ringed-space module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor].

Prove the private helper epi_over_of_local_lifts: on Over U the image sieve of a section is covering because each point belongs to a member of the supplied open cover with a lift. Sieve.overEquiv_iff identifies the over-site sieve with the open-set sieve. Mathlib Sheaf.epi_of_isLocallySurjective gives an epimorphism after forgetting to abelian sheaves, and the faithful toSheaf functor reflects epimorphisms. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk] to phi to obtain (3).

Prove the private helper finiteType_zero_near, following Modules 01B9: apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk] to the zero endomorphism of an arbitrary finite-type module H. Its stalk map is surjective when H_x is zero, since the target carrier is a subsingleton by ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton. The previous helper makes the restricted zero endomorphism an epimorphism. IsZero.of_epi_zero then shows H restricted to U is zero. Apply to F for (1). This uses no chosen data from an unproved existence theorem in any definition.

For (2), [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-finite-type-sub-kernel] (2) makes kernel(phi) finite type from hG.1 and hF. Mathlib evaluation preserves kernels and therefore monomorphisms, so the kernel inclusion is injective on every open. Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_app_injective makes its underlying additive stalk map injective, hence its linear stalk map is mono. The composite of this map with the injective phi_x is zero by kernel.condition and functoriality. Cancel the mono phi_x to see the kernel-inclusion stalk map is zero; IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero makes its source stalk zero. Apply the preceding finiteType_zero_near helper to the kernel. For V contained in U, evaluation of the zero restricted kernel is zero. Map ShortComplex.kernelSequence_exact through evaluation using map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel; Exact.mono_g gives mono, hence injectivity, of phi_V.

For (4), take U to be the intersection of the neighborhoods supplied by the injective-stalk argument and [lem-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk]. Local lifts on every W contained in U are inherited from the latter neighborhood and give Epi(phi.over U) by epi_over_of_local_lifts. To prove Mono(phi.over U), compare any two morphisms after composition with it: evaluation on an object of Over U gives equal sections after applying phi_V, and injectivity on the former neighborhood cancels phi_V. Extensionality proves equality of the morphisms. The category of module sheaves is abelian, so Mathlib isIso_of_mono_of_epi gives the required isomorphism. This categorical balancedness theorem packages the sheaf gluing argument from the original plan.

lean.statement: theorem coherent_local_isomorphism (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F G : SheafOfModules (moduleRings X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRingedSpace)) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRingedSpace F) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRingedSpace G) (φ : G ⟶ F) (x : X) : (IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj F) → ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsZero (F.over U)) ∧ (Function.Injective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map φ) → ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∀ (V : X.Opens), V ≤ U → Function.Injective (ConcreteCategory.hom (φ.val.app (.op V)))) ∧ (Function.Surjective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map φ) → ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ Epi ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRingedSpace) U).map φ)) ∧ (Function.Bijective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map φ) → ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRingedSpace) U).map φ))

reviewed_lean.note: X Scheme.{u} + [IsLocallyNoetherian X]; F,G SheafOfModules over moduleRings with RingedSpace.IsCoherent; φ : G ⟶ F; x; stalks/stalk maps switched from Mathlib ModuleCat.of stalk + upstream Scheme.Modules.Hom.stalkLinearMap to RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor obj/map; (1) IsZero stalk -> ∃U∋x IsZero (F.over U); (2) injective -> ∃U∋x ∀V≤U section maps injective; (3) surjective -> ∃U∋x Epi (overFunctor U).map φ; (4) bijective -> ∃U∋x IsIso, all tied existentials
